turns.speaker: Dr. Watson
turns.text: Indeed, Your Majesty, it is clear now. May I ask what specific assistance you require from Mr. Holmes?

turns.speaker: Sherlock Holmes
turns.text: Your Majesty, the nature of your visit is indeed of a delicate and serious nature. Pray, elucidate the specifics of your predicament so I may determine the most efficacious course of action.

turns.speaker: the King of Bohemia
turns.text: I fear that the matter at hand involves the queen's sister, whom I must protect from a scandal that could jeopardize the stability of our kingdom. Can you assist me in uncovering the truth and ensuring her safety?

turns.speaker: Sherlock Holmes
turns.text: Your Majesty, I appreciate the gravity of your situation. Let us proceed to the details of the scandal and the means by which you wish me to intervene.

turns.speaker: the King of Bohemia
turns.text: Indeed, the situation is dire. The scandal revolves around letters and photographs that could implicate my sister-in-law in an affair with a foreign noble. I need these items retrieved and the identity of the person behind this threat to my family's honor established.

turns.speaker: Dr. Watson
turns.text: I understand the delicacy of the situation, Your Majesty. Mr. Holmes will certainly approach this matter with the utmost discretion.

turns.speaker: the King of Bohemia
turns.text: I trust Mr. Holmes implicitly, and I will provide him with all necessary information to commence his investigation. Let us proceed without further delay.

turns.speaker: Dr. Watson
turns.text: Mr. Holmes, shall I assist in gathering any preliminary information or would you prefer to handle this directly with the King?

turns.speaker: Sherlock Holmes
turns.text: Doctor, I shall require your assistance in this matter. Your observations will be invaluable. Your Majesty, if you would be so kind as to provide me with the specific details of the scandal and the whereabouts of the threatening individual.

turns.speaker: the King of Bohemia
turns.text: Very well, Mr. Holmes. The individual behind this scheme is known only by his alias, 'The Red-headed League'. He has been threatening to reveal the scandalous evidence against my sister-in-law, and I fear for the stability of my kingdom should these secrets come to light.

turns.speaker: Dr. Watson
turns.text: I will do my best to assist you, Mr. Holmes. Shall we begin by taking a detailed statement from the King of Bohemia?

turns.speaker: Sherlock Holmes
turns.text: Let us retire to a more private setting, Your Majesty, where we may discuss this matter in confidence.

turns.speaker: the King of Bohemia
turns.text: Indeed, Mr. Holmes. I shall divulge all necessary information with the utmost confidentiality. Let us proceed to a more secluded area.

turns.speaker: Sherlock Holmes
turns.text: Lead the way, Your Majesty. Dr. Watson, kindly fetch your notebook and pen. We must document every detail.

turns.speaker: the King of Bohemia
turns.text: Indeed, I trust Mr. Holmes and Dr. Watson implicitly. Let us move to the study where we may speak without fear of prying ears.

turns.speaker: Sherlock Holmes
turns.text: Very well, let us not waste a moment.

turns.speaker: the King of Bohemia
turns.text: I shall proceed at once to the study, accompanied by Mr. Holmes and Dr. Watson. Let us not linger here.

turns.speaker: Dr. Watson
turns.text: I shall retrieve my notebook and pen at once, as Holmes requested.

turns.speaker: Sherlock Holmes
turns.text: I shall precede you then, Your Majesty, and prepare the study for our discussion.

turns.speaker: the King of Bohemia
turns.text: I shall follow closely behind, ensuring that our conversation remains confidential.

opening.speaker: the King of Bohemia
opening.text: You had my note? I told you that I would call.

opening.speaker: Sherlock Holmes
opening.text: Pray take a seat. This is my friend and colleague, Dr. Watson, who is occasionally good enough to help me in my cases. Whom have I the honour to address?

opening.speaker: the King of Bohemia
opening.text: You may address me as the Count Von Kramm, a Bohemian nobleman. I understand that this gentleman, your friend, is a man of honour and discretion, whom I may trust with a matter of the most extreme importance. If not, I should much prefer to communicate with you alone.

opening.speaker: the King of Bohemia
opening.text: Then I must begin. I must bind you both to absolute secrecy for two years; at the end of that time the matter will be of no importance. At present it is not too much to say that it is of such weight it may have an influence upon European history.

opening.speaker: the King of Bohemia
opening.text: You will excuse this mask. The august person who employs me wishes his agent to be unknown to you, and I may confess at once that the title by which I have just called myself is not exactly my own.

opening.speaker: the King of Bohemia
opening.text: The circumstances are of great delicacy, and every precaution has to be taken to quench what might grow to be an immense scandal and seriously compromise one of the reigning families of Europe. To speak plainly, the matter implicates the great House of Ormstein, hereditary kings of Bohemia.

opening.speaker: Sherlock Holmes
opening.text: I was also aware of that.

opening.speaker: the King of Bohemia
opening.text: If your Majesty would condescend to state your case, I should be better able to advise you.

opening.speaker: the King of Bohemia
opening.text: You are right. I am the King. Why should I attempt to conceal it?
